body: Actually, your change eliminates a failsafe performed here, where it aborts with an error if the file reaches EOL before the string can be fully read (i.e. `pos + len >= EOL)` . You should do something similar in the `else` branch.
I'm guessing an `eof_reached` check works. Added.
From a quick check, it looks like it won't be set when seeking to _exactly_ the end (instead of over), so I think you're right.
